toegepas.voor: water en die gesin dra dit
toegepas.na: water, en die gesin dra dit
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: both joined clauses have their own subject and verb ('n watervragmotor bring; die gesin dra), so a comma goes before en; net word change 0.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n munisipale watervragmotor bring; die gesin dra).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves are full clauses with their own subjects, so the comma is required; no words or meaning change.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'het self 'n hospitaal' is unidiomatic for 'has its own hospital'; 'n eie' is the natural form and matches the lesson's own 'eie kraan'; net word change 0.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Haar dorp het self 'n hospitaal' is natural Afrikaans (compare 'Ek het self 'n motor') and its emphatic 'self' carries the contrast with Thabo's distant hospital; the proposal is a lateral move.
